name: Lesson 1 School now
unit_name: Unit 3 School: now, then and future
definition: 学习用 there is/are 和现在时介绍现在的学校规模与设施。
key_points: 核心词汇：playground 操场, basketball court 篮球场, teaching building 教学楼, classroom 教室, garden 花园, dining hall 餐厅, library 图书馆, computer 电脑, student 学生, teacher 老师, carrot 胡萝卜, tomato 西红柿, potato 土豆, green bean 青豆
核心句型：There is a big playground in our school.
Is there / Are there...?（一般疑问句）
How many ... are there?（询问数量）
语法点：there be 句型的一般现在时（There is/are ...）；可数名词单复数与 be 动词的一致；一般疑问句及回答
common_mistakes: There be 句型 be 动词的单复数容易用错（There are a book ❌）
How many 后面漏掉复数名词
publisher: 广东教育出版社（粤教沪外教版）
